data.name: Khawlah
data.gender_notes: Khawlah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Khawlah bint Tha'labah was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). She was known for her intelligence, courage, and loyalty. The name Khawlah carries the meaning “Companion of the Prophet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khawlah usually hope their child will grow to embody companion of the prophet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of loyalty and companionship
data.etymology: Khawlah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Companion of the Prophet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khawlah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: خوة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني الحميمة و الصداقة و الألفة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من كلمة 'خول' و يعني الحميمة و الصداقة و الألفة. ورد ذكر اسم خولة في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة، و هي من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و قيمة روحية عالية في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: خولہ
in_urdu.meaning: خولہ کا مطلب ہے قرب و خلوص، دوستی اور محبت
in_urdu.long_meaning: خولہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عربى جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے قرب و خلوص، دوستی اور محبت۔ خولہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے، خاص طور پر قرآنی اشارات کے ساتھ جہاں خولة بنت الحارثة کا ذکر آتا ہے

in_hindi.name: खौला
in_hindi.meaning: खौला नाम का अर्थ है स्नेह, मित्रता और प्रेम
in_hindi.long_meaning: खौला एक सुंदर और महत्वपूर्ण नाम है जो इस्लामी परंपरा में पाया जाता है। यह नाम स्नेह, मित्रता और प्रेम का प्रतीक है। खौला नाम का उल्लेख कुरआन में भी मिलता है, जो इसे एक पवित्र और आध्यात्मिक महत्व देता है

in_pashto.name: خوله
in_pashto.meaning: خوله د يوې ښځې نوم دی چې معنی يې د مينې، دوستۍ او يوالی
in_pashto.long_meaning: خوله نوم د پښتو کلتور کې د يوې ښځې لپاره کارول کيږي. دا نوم د مينې، دوستۍ او يوالی معنی لري. په پښتني ټولنه کې، دا نوم د ښځو لپاره د احترام او قدر سره استعماليږي

in_english.name: Khawlah
in_english.meaning: Khawlah means intimacy, friendship, and affection in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Khawlah is a feminine given name in Arabic, derived from the root 'kh-w-l' which signifies intimacy, friendship, and affection. This name holds historical significance as it is mentioned in the Quran, specifically referring to Khawlah bint al-Haritha, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name embodies spiritual values of love, loyalty, and companionship, making it a cherished choice in Islamic tradition

data.cultural_impact: The name "Khawlah" is a reminder of an important figure in Islamic history who embodied qualities such as intelligence, courage, and loyalty. It is a name that inspires young Muslim girls to strive for excellence and unwavering commitment to their faith and community.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Khawlah" has deep spiritual significance as it is a reminder of a noble companion who devoted her life to the service of Allah and His Prophet (peace be upon him). It is a name that evokes the spirit of courage and determination in the face of adversity, as well as the importance of intelligence and knowledge in the pursuit of truth and guidance from Allah. May Allah bless us all with the qualities of Khawlah bint Tha'labah, and inspire us to strive for excellence in all aspects of our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Companion of the Prophet" symbolizes Khawlah bint Tha'labah was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). She was known for her intelligence, courage, and loyalty.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Khawlah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of companion of the prophet.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that The name Khawlah is mentioned in the Hadith of Sahih Bukhari. The name Khawlah carried significant weight in that era.
